name: Long Table
best_for: Food, culture and curated creative presentations
avoid_for: Decks that need corporate polish, technical density, or a cold / minimalist register — the rust-red palette and bold serif mix are intentionally warm and people-facing
weak_cases: Long technical paragraphs or code do not fit its curated programme rhythm.
visual_signature: Rust on buttery paper, uppercase Bricolage, Fraunces italic and dotted print texture.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Uppercase display and italic body are distinctive; another script needs separate hierarchy and spacing choices.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
